example_sentences_in_bangla: চীনা মাঞ্জার সুতো এতটাই ধারালো যে এটি গলা কাটা সহজেই সম্ভব।
সেই তারের কাটা এত গভীর যে রক্ত বেরিয়ে আসছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The Chinese kite string is so sharp that it can easily cut a throat.
The cut from that wire is so deep that blood is flowing out.
history: Refers to the dangers of Chinese manja (kite string) used during festivals like Pohela Boishakh or Durga Puja in Bengal, where sharp strings have caused injuries to cyclists and pedestrians on bridges.
note: This appears to describe a hazardous situation rather than a traditional idiom, rooted in urban kite-flying practices.
